summary: Deliberately vulnerable lab service for authorized CI testing only.

remediation.config_change: Remove GET / from production builds or require an administrator session; never serialize configuration values into responses; move secrets to an injected secret store so they cannot appear in any dump.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/" "id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-1fcca4728961d56d',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'"
{"class":"info-disclosure","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-1fcca4728961d56d","id":9100011,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/\" \"id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-1fcca4728961d56d',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'\""}

summary: CORS policy allows unrestricted origins, exposing the application to XSS, DoS, and other attacks.

remediation.config_change: Replace Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with an explicit allowlist of origins compared exactly; never combine a wildcard or reflected origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; omit CORS headers for same-origin APIs.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin "@streq *" "id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-6016341fd5b70be1',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'"
{"class":"cors-misconfig","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-6016341fd5b70be1","id":9100013,"rule":"SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin \"@streq *\" \"id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-6016341fd5b70be1',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'\""}

summary: Path traversal vulnerability in `/files` endpoint allows accessing arbitrary files via malformed `name` parameter.

remediation.code_diff:
--- a/handlers/files.go
+++ b/handlers/files.go
@@ -4,6 +4,7 @@
 	"net/http"
 	"os"
 	"path/filepath"
+	"strings"
 )
 
 // files serves a file from the public directory by name.
@@ -13,10 +14,20 @@
 		http.Error(w, "name required", http.StatusBadRequest)
 		return
 	}
-	p := filepath.Join(s.opts.PublicDir, name) // VULN: path-traversal joined path is never checked to stay inside PublicDir
+	base, err := filepath.Abs(s.opts.PublicDir)
+	if err != nil {
+		http.Error(w, "unavailable", http.StatusInternalServerError)
+		return
+	}
+	p := filepath.Join(base, filepath.Clean("/"+name))
+	rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, p)
+	if err != nil || rel == ".." || strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator)) {
+		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
+		return
+	}
 	data, err := os.ReadFile(p)
 	if err != nil {
-		http.Error(w, "not found: "+p, http.StatusNotFound)
+		http.Error(w, "not found", http.StatusNotFound)
 		return
 	}
 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
remediation.config_change: On GET /files, resolve name against the base directory, clean it, and refuse any result that does not stay inside the base (filepath.Rel without a leading ..); or map names to files through a fixed table.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:name "@rx (?:\.\./|\.\.\\|%2e%2e)" "id:9100009,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay path-traversal virtual patch f-b90b52b92bc24e26',tag:'assay/path-traversal'"
{"class":"path-traversal","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-b90b52b92bc24e26","id":9100009,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:name \"@rx (?:\\.\\./|\\.\\.\\\\|%2e%2e)\" \"id:9100009,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay path-traversal virtual patch f-b90b52b92bc24e26',tag:'assay/path-traversal'\""}

summary: No rate limiting headers detected; exposure to brute-force and DDoS attacks is possible.

validation.note: 16 identical paced GET requests in two batches, none rate-limited (observational)

remediation.config_change: Rate-limit GET / per account and per source address (for example 5 attempts per minute with exponential backoff); add account lockout or step-up verification after repeated failures.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule IP:LOGIN_ATTEMPTS "@gt 5" "id:9100016,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay rate-limit-missing virtual patch f-c956a05045926760',tag:'assay/rate-limit-missing'"
{"class":"rate-limit-missing","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-c956a05045926760","id":9100016,"rule":"SecRule IP:LOGIN_ATTEMPTS \"@gt 5\" \"id:9100016,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay rate-limit-missing virtual patch f-c956a05045926760',tag:'assay/rate-limit-missing'\""}

summary: XSS injection vulnerability in the search endpoint.

validation.note: benign tag reflected unescaped in HTML

remediation.config_change: HTML-escape term before writing it into the page for GET /search (html/template or the framework's auto-escaping renderer); send Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8 and a Content-Security-Policy without 'unsafe-inline'.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:term "@detectXSS" "id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-a0cb21c9adcc085f',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'"
{"class":"xss-reflected","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-a0cb21c9adcc085f","id":9100002,"rule":"SecRule ARGS:term \"@detectXSS\" \"id:9100002,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:htmlEntityDecode,msg:'assay xss-reflected virtual patch f-a0cb21c9adcc085f',tag:'assay/xss-reflected'\""}

summary: Healthcheck endpoint contains a SQL injection vulnerability.

remediation.config_change: Replace string concatenation with a parameterized query (placeholders and bound arguments) for GET /healthcheck parameter <parameter>; reject input that fails a strict allowlist before it reaches the database; run the application's database role with SELECT-only grants where the endpoint only reads.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule ARGS:* "@detectSQLi" "id:9100001,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sqli virtual patch f-cdfe850c885d5dda',tag:'assay/sqli'"
